column1:
Kinetix 5100 Servo Drive Parameters 
For more information see:

Kinetix 5100 Servo Drive User Manual, 
publication 2198-UM004

column10:
Motor Type

0 = Rotary Permanent Magnet
1 = Reserved
2 = Linear Motor.
3 = Induction Machine

Motor Rated Continuous Current
The Min value must not be less than DriveRatedContinuousCurrent/8. e.g. The Rated Continuous Current of 2198-E1004-ERS is 2.60 A, so the min value is 33 (0.325 A).
Motor Rated Output Power at Rated Frequency
Number of poles in the motor
Motor Rated Speed at Rated Frequency

Encoder Type

Y: Hall element setting
0 = Digital AqB without UVW
1 = Digital AqB with UVW

Phase Sequence

X: Encoder feedback polarity
0=Encoder feedback direction is the same as the UVW current direction
1=Encoder feedback direction is opposite to the UVW current direction
Y: Hall feedback polarity
0=Hall feedback direction is the same as the UVW current direction
1=Hall feedback direction is opposite to the UVW current direction
Z: Motor polarity
0=CW
1=CCW

Commutation Offset
See Select a Motor and Configure Feedback in KNX5100C Software in the user manual.

Electrical Angle Correction

Bit4:
0 = Disable
1 = Enable

Motor Temperature Sensor Type
Reserved for future release.

Motor Temperature Sensor Resistance
Reserved for future release.

Motor Rated Peak Current
The Min value must not be less than DriveRatedContinuousCurrent/8. For example, the Rated Continuous Current of 2198-E1004-ERS is 2.60 A, so the min value is 33 (0.33 A).
Permanent Magnet Motor Bemf Voltage Constant

Motor Data Source

0 = Motor NV
1 = Catalog Number
2 = Nameplate Datasheet
See Select a Motor and Configure Feedback in KNX5100C Software in the user manual.

Motor Overload Limit

0 = Disable
1…100 for Surface Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
1…200 for third party motors

Commutation Alignment (Startup) 
Determine the commutation alignment during startup.

0 = Motor Offset
1 = Self Sensing
2 = Drive Offset
See Select a Motor and Configure Feedback in KNX5100C Software in the user manual.

Motor Date Code

Month (bit 31-24)
Day (bit 23-16)
Year (bit 15-0)

Permanent Magnet Motor Rated Force
Reserved for future release.

Total Inertia
when PN.045 is 0, PN.044 cannot be changed, LoadInertiaRatio ID 144 (P1.037) can be changed.
When PN.045 is 1, PN.044 can be changed, LoadInertiaRatio ID 144 (P1.037) cannot be changed.
When PN.045 is changed from 0 to 1, PN.044 will be changed automatically based on P1.037. When PN.045 is changed from 1 to 0, P1.037 will be changed automatically based on PN.044

Use Load Ratio
Reserved for future release.
when PN.045 is 0, PN.044 cannot be changed, LoadInertiaRatio ID 144 P1.037 can be changed.
When PN.045 is 1, PN.044 can be changed, LoadInertiaRatio ID 144 P1.037 cannot be changed.
When PN.045 is changed from 0 to 1, PN.044 will be changed automatically based on P1.037. When PN.045 is changed from 1 to 0, P1.037 will be changed automatically based on PN.044

Encoder Communication Protocol

0x0000 = No Encoder/AqB
0x0003 = Nikon
0x3209 = Hiperface SKS
0x3709 = Hiperface SKM
0x2209 = Hiperface SRS
0x2709 = Hiperface SRM
